integrity: Analytic proof supplies the universal statement. Finite numerical integration and algebraic checks are only supplementary; no independent validation or historical uniqueness is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact jet cutoff is optimal for the entire variational objective but is not claimed to be the minimum information necessary for just the minimizing polynomial. The result requires an inner generator and even Hardy exponent. Schur interpolation is a known ingredient, not a new interpolation theorem.
title: Sharp finite-jet reduction of even-exponent Hardy approximation for inner functions
